baseline_models.focus_anchor: The purpose construction links خَلَقْتُ at word 2 through الجن والإنس at words 3-4 to لِيَعْبُدُونِ at word 6.
baseline_models.mechanism: Creative bringing-into-being establishes two creature classes and closes their stated telos around worshipful obedience.

activation_trace.role: Bringing creation into existence supplies the event whose end is stated.
Hidden jinn supply one complete class placed under the purpose clause.
Manifest humanity supplies the coordinated class sharing the same end.
Worshipful obedience with humility supplies the exclusive purpose.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely reports that jinn and humans were created.
changed_reading.after: Their existence is explicitly purposive, with both classes gathered under worshipful obedience.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated الجن and الإنس place roots of concealment and manifest human presence side by side.
baseline_models.mechanism: Opposite modes of creaturely presence, concealed and humanly apparent or sociable, converge on one relation to the Creator.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies the hidden pole of the coordinated pair.
Visible humanity supplies the manifest pole opposed to hiddenness.
Sociability thickens the human pole into relational presence.
Shared worship makes the two modes converge functionally.

changed_reading.before: Jinn and humans are only adjacent taxonomic labels.
changed_reading.after: They also form a hidden-manifest polarity subordinated to one creaturely vocation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The first-person Creator and the root ع ب د establish a creator-servant relation, not merely a named ritual.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ownership and subjection branches thicken worship into total allegiance, while the direct worship branch keeps that allegiance devotional.

activation_trace.role: The originating act grounds the asymmetry of the relation.
Servitude under ownership supplies the relation's comprehensive claim.
Subjection into service supplies allegiance beyond isolated acts.
Worshipful obedience fixes the relation's devotional center.

changed_reading.before: Worship consists chiefly of episodic devotional acts.
changed_reading.after: Worship names a total creator-creature allegiance expressed through obedient devotion.

context_deltas.mechanism: A messenger bears authority, Pharaoh turns away through his supporting power, and a people rebel against their Lord's command; worship therefore functions as contested allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Obedient worship supplies the focus relation placed in political contrast.
Authority and jurisdiction supply the public field of confrontation.
Turning away supplies Pharaoh's enacted refusal.
A strong supporting side supplies the rival power base on which refusal leans.
Rebellion from obedience supplies the negative mirror of worship.
Binding command supplies the demand rejected by rebellion.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the rightful pole of allegiance.

structural_cues: 51:38-39 moves from sent authority to a ruler's turning through his own support.
51:44 names rebellion specifically against the command of their Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authority, rival support, turning, command, and lordship; I infer an allegiance contest illuminating ع ب د. A narrower alternative is generic disobedience.

changed_reading.before: Worship is primarily private ritual observance.
changed_reading.after: Worship is comprehensive allegiance to rightful lordship that displaces rival authorities.

context_deltas.mechanism: The root naming jinn appears twice as مجنون in accusations against messengers, while clarity and deceptive diversion flank it; hiddenness is echoed as a humanly imposed covering of understanding.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies the shared image from which the contextual shift begins.
Human perception supplies the faculty whose response to disclosure is at issue.
Manifest disclosure supplies the clarity that accusation obscures.
Diversion and deception supply one dismissive relabeling of the sign.
Covering of reason converts concealment into cognitive occlusion.
Attributing what is not so supplies the repeated communal misdescription.
The repeated madness accusation confirms patterned cognitive covering.

structural_cues: The paired accusation ساحر أو مجنون occurs at 51:39 and 51:52.
The second occurrence generalizes the response across messengers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a root fork between hidden beings and covered reason, plus disclosure and diversion; I infer an epistemic mirror in which manifest humans hide a clear summons from themselves. Simple polysemy remains live.

changed_reading.before: الجن only identifies an unseen species.
changed_reading.after: Its concealment root also mirrors the visible hearers' cognitive hiding when they call disclosure madness.

context_deltas.mechanism: A barren wind reduces things to decay, then rebellion ends in inability and failed standing; the ط و ع branches join obedience and ability, making refusal look like a reversal of creaturely viability.

activation_trace.role: Created existence supplies the positive condition reversed by destruction.
Obedient worship supplies the alignment contrasted with incapacity.
A barren wind supplies an anti-fruitful force.
Decay supplies the material endpoint opposed to formed creation.
Rebellion supplies the volitional break preceding incapacity.
Obedient yielding supplies the latent counterpart inside inability.
Capacity supplies the power lost after refusal.
Bodily standing supplies the concrete image of lost viability.

structural_cues: 51:41-42 moves from barrenness to decayed matter.
51:44-45 moves from rebellion against command to inability and failed standing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies barrenness, decay, rebellion, ability-obedience polysemy, and failed standing; I infer an arrow from refused alignment to de-creation imagery. Judicial destruction without an ontological claim remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Worship is an external test added after creation.
changed_reading.after: Worship can be read as alignment with viable creaturely standing, while rebellion is imaged as capacity collapsing toward remains.

context_deltas.mechanism: Heaven is assembled and widened, earth spread and prepared, and measured creation paired toward recollection; worship becomes the fitting response of situated creatures within an ordered world.

activation_trace.role: Measured formation supplies the focus side of a designed-world mechanism.
Worshipful obedience supplies the response to that ordering.
Joining parts into a construction supplies upper-world architecture.
Expansiveness supplies amplitude rather than a cramped order.
Spreading and furnishing supplies a habitable lower field.
Preparing and leveling supplies deliberate suitability.
Measured creation repeats the focus root and links world order to purpose.
Counterpart joined to counterpart supplies relational ordering.
Reminder supplies the cognitive response prepared by paired creation.

structural_cues: The focus repeats خ ل ق and turns that sequence toward the purpose of two creature classes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies construction, expansion, furnishing, preparation, pairing, and reminder; I infer worship as the fitted response enabled by this habitat. The alternative is a looser signs-to-reflection sequence.

changed_reading.before: The focus gives an isolated demand detached from material and cosmic life.
changed_reading.after: Worship is a situated response within a measured, spacious, furnished, relational world.

context_deltas.mechanism: Flight has one destination, rival deity-making is prohibited, inherited refusal is exposed, and beneficial reminder renews assent; worship becomes exclusive return sustained against social counter-scripts.

activation_trace.role: Sociability supplies the human medium through which orientations circulate.
Worship supplies the orientation being renewed and contested.
Urgent flight supplies active movement toward one destination.
The deity relation supplies the rightful object and prohibited rival slot.
Otherness supplies the excluded alternate destination.
Mutual counsel supplies the proposed channel of inherited refusal.
Crossing the limit supplies the social counter-orientation.
Reminder supplies the rival beneficial transmission.
Benefit supplies the effect of receptive reminder.
Heart-settling assent supplies the receptive endpoint.

structural_cues: 51:50-51 pairs movement to Allah with refusal of another deity.
51:52-55 contrasts a repeated communal accusation with beneficial reminder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directed flight, exclusive deity language, mutual counsel, transgression, reminder, benefit, and assent; I infer competing social channels of orientation. Repentance and reminder may remain distinct acts within broader worship.

changed_reading.before: Worship is undirected religiosity performed by isolated agents.
changed_reading.after: Worship is repeated return toward one divine object while social speech either obstructs or renews that direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequel twice negates divine desire for creaturely provision or feeding and identifies God as the strong, firm provider; servant language is stripped of an extractive labor economy.

activation_trace.role: Owned servitude supplies the economic-looking baseline the sequel qualifies.
Subjection to labor supplies the extraction model context denies.
Devotional obedience preserves positive content after extraction is removed.
Twice-negated desire denies that divine purpose seeks creaturely goods.
Allocated provision supplies the first commodity God does not request.
Feeding another supplies the support service God does not need.
The giver of provision reverses the flow from master to servant.
Concentrated strength supplies independence from creaturely support.
Extended solidity supplies durable self-sufficiency.

structural_cues: 51:57 immediately follows the purpose statement with two parallel مَا أُرِيدُ negations.
51:58 reverses the economic direction by naming God provider, strong, and firm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied provision and feeding plus divine provision and strength; I infer that worship orders or benefits creatures rather than filling a lack in the Creator. The exact creature-side benefit remains unstated.

changed_reading.before: Creaturely service might resemble labor supplying a needy master.
changed_reading.after: Worship is non-extractive dependence on the One who supplies servants and needs neither provisions nor feeding.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wrongdoers receive a share like their companions at an appointed promise; the measuring branch of creation is echoed by proportionate allocation and timed accountability.

activation_trace.role: Measuring supplies the focus-side design image echoed by consequence.
Obedient worship supplies the purpose against which accountability is assessed.
An apportioned share supplies distributive consequence.
A filled bucket supplies a measured-container image behind the share.
Equivalence supplies proportionality with their companions' lot.
Companionship supplies the comparison class.
A promise fixed to time supplies the appointed horizon.

structural_cues: 51:59 follows denial of divine need with a measured share for wrongdoers.
51:60 closes the window on the promised day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies share, container imagery, equivalence, companions, and appointed promise; I infer measured creation opening into measured accountability. The sin branch of ذ ن ب remains live and may dominate.

changed_reading.before: The creation purpose states vocation without a distributive horizon.
changed_reading.after: The vocation sits within measured accountability: refusal receives a proportionate, appointed lot.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The road-leveling branch is material and form-distant from the finite verb, but it remains anchored in ع ب د and is activated by prepared earth and flight. Render only as a spatial analogy, never as the lexical replacement of يعبدون.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root ع ب د at word 6 includes making a road or vehicle tractable and serviceable.

activation_trace.role: Leveling and making traversable supplies the material service analogy.
Spreading the ground supplies the traversable field.
Preparing and leveling activates the material branch.
Flight toward God supplies motion across the prepared field.

changed_reading.before: Worship is only a set of cultic performances.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, worship is also imaged as taking a creaturely way made serviceable toward God.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The honor branch is associated with a derived nominal and cannot reverse the grammar so that humans are worshipped. It remains worth carrying because it is rooted in ع ب د and the sequel removes divine need. Render only the possibility that serving may dignify the servant.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root ع ب د at word 6 includes a branch in which the served figure is honored or magnified.

activation_trace.role: Honor within the root field supplies a possible dignity dimension.
Negated feeding removes service as satisfaction of divine lack.
Divine provision supplies the beneficent direction toward the servant.
Independent strength blocks an exploitative rationale.

changed_reading.before: Servitude can only signify humiliation for a master's benefit.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, non-extractive service may also be the relation through which the dependent creature is dignified.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The scattered-directions branch belongs to a remote plural nominal. It remains anchored in ع ب د and is activated by flight to one destination plus exclusion of another deity. Render as a controlled directional metaphor, not the denotation of يعبدون.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root ع ب د at word 6 contains a branch of groups or roads dispersing in multiple directions.

activation_trace.role: Dispersion across directions supplies the counter-image to unified worship.
Flight supplies motion gathered toward one pole.
The worshipped object supplies the unifying destination.
The prohibited other supplies the rival direction.

changed_reading.before: Worship is one activity among many trajectories.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, worship gathers scattered creaturely directions into flight toward one divine pole.

strongest_changes: Authority and rebellion turn worship from private rite into contested allegiance.
The obedience-ability link and failed standing make rebellion read like lost creaturely viability.
The immediate denial of provision and feeding removes an extractive service model.
The built and furnished world makes worship a situated response to measured hospitality.
The repeated مجنون echo turns the jinn root into a mirror of human cognitive concealment.
summary.what_was_special: Exact root forks and reversals drove the trace: ج ن ن moves from hidden beings to covered reason, ط و ع joins obedience to capacity, and ع ب د servant imagery is immediately corrected by the Creator-provider's lack of need.
remaining_uncertainties: The de-creation sequence may describe judicial consequence without saying worship causally sustains existence.
Measured creation may support purposive fitness without implying innate determinism.
The prepared-path, dignity, and gathered-directions outliers are form-distant and must remain qualified analogies.
